missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Мотор' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'работает'. 'Тихо' is the adverb of manner, and 'очень' intensifies it. A clean engine description.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Мотор' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative equals the nominative. 'Старый' agrees in the masculine accusative, and 'чинит' takes it as its object.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. After 'нет' the noun takes the genitive 'мотора'. 'У этой машины' frames the possessor, marking what the car lacks.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Из мотора' uses the genitive after 'из' to show origin. 'Дым' is the nominative subject, and 'чёрный' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К мотору' takes the dative after 'к' to express direction of attention. 'Прислушался' marks the completed act of listening closely.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Мотором' is the instrumental marking the means of propulsion. 'Лодка' is the nominative subject, and 'движется' describes the motion.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В моторе' uses the prepositional 'моторе' after 'в' to show location within. 'Что то' is the indefinite subject, and 'сломалось' is the neuter verb.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a number. After 'два' the noun takes the genitive singular 'мотора'. 'Стоят' agrees with the plural notion, and 'на складе' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Моторы' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'на бензине' is the prepositional describing the fuel.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Моторы' is the inanimate masculine plural accusative, matching the nominative plural. 'Мощные' agrees in the plural, and 'выпускает' takes them as objects.
